title: Aceh has the broadest autonomy in Indonesia and the deepest poverty in Sumatra — the fix is execution, not more autonomy on paper.
sourceLine: Source: BPS Aceh BRS 5 Feb 2026 and 6 Aug 2026; Qanun Aceh 1/2026 (APBA 2026); Kemenko Polkam via Kompas 18 Jun 2026; UU 11/2006 Ps 183. [1][3][9][15][26][27]
